description: This Java source file defines the ConceptNameInUseException class, an API exception used in the OpenMRS project to indicate that a concept name is already in use, typically when attempting to delete or modify a concept's name while it is linked to observations.

classes.name: ConceptNameInUseException
classes.description: An exception class extending APIException, thrown when a concept's name is in use by observations and operation (like delete or modify) is attempted.

methods.name: ConceptNameInUseException
methods.description: Default constructor providing a standard message indicating the concept name cannot be changed if it is in use.

methods.description: Constructor accepting a custom message to specify why the exception was thrown.

methods.name: ConceptNameInUseException
methods.description: Constructor accepting a message and a cause, enabling exception chaining with a custom message.
